tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: rtsa gsum spyi yi las byang kun gsal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// rtsa gsum spyi yi las byang 'di// pad+ma 'byung gnas byin rlabs kyis// sngon gyi las 'phro cung zad tsam// sad snyam byed pa bdag gis bri// dang po skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa ni/ na mo/ dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum// kun la gtan du skyabs su mchi// 'gro kun sangs rgyas 'thob pa'i phyir// bdag gis gsang sngags bsgrub par bgyi/ /de nas bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐/ snang srid 'khor 'das gzhal yas lha// de ltar ma rtogs 'khrul snang bgegs// gzhan du dengs shig 'da' byed na/ khro chung mtshon cha 'bar bas brlag /sum+bha ni sogs brjod/ mtshams gcad ni/ hūm̐/ 'khor 'das chos sku gdal khyab la// lha 'drer 'dzin pa rang sar grol// ye shes lnga yi 'od gur 'khrigs// dug lnga'i dgra bgegs mtshams chod cig / de nas yan lag bdun pas sngon 'gro phal cher tshang bar bstan pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sku gsum rol pa'i lha tshogs la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul 'gal 'khrul bshags// dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor// gsol btab dge bcu 'gro la bsngo// byin 'beb ni/ phyogs bcu rgyal ba'i zhing khams nas// sku gsum zhi khro'i gar ston pa// 'khor bcas byin phob dbang mchog skur// dngos grub rnam gnyis bstsal du gsol// mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ swā bhā ba sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ stong las dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi// phyi nang gsang mchod sman raka gtor// zag med ye shes bdud rtsi che// 'dzad med snang srid kun 'gengs gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ha ho hrīḥ de nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos kun dmigs med stong pa che// de dang snying rje gnyis su med// zung 'jug 'phro 'du'i hrīḥhūm̐ bh+yo// la sogs rgyu yi sa bon gsal// de nas gzhal yas khang bskyed ni/ hūm̐/ gdos bcas bral ba stong pa yi// rang rtsal rlung me chu sa dang*// kun khyab nam mkha' yum lnga'i mkhar// ye shes rang 'od 'khrigs pa las// gzhan yas khang pa mtshan nyid rdzogs// rgyan spras phyi nang sgrib bral dbus// pad nyi bam sogs rang rang gi

/gdan rnams so sor bkra bar gsal// de nas lha bskyed so sor shes la/ lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ khro rol phur bu'i mngon rtogs ni/ hūm̐ las skad cig dran rdzogs su/ khro rol phur bu zhal gsum pa// g.yas dkar g.yon mthing dbus dmar nag /g.yas gsum rdo rje tho ba me// g.yon gsum bhan+dha phur bu sdig /gshog gdengs phur mjug dgra bgegs gzir/ khro bo'i chas rdzogs 'jigs su rung*// dpral mgrin thugs ka lte gsang du// 'jam dpal rta mgrin gsang ba'i bdag /mkha' 'gro lnga dang me dbal gsal// spyi bor rigs bdag khros pa dang*/ khyung dmar 'phyo ba me dpung dbus/ khro bo khro mo'i 'khor tshogs gsal// kun gyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum brgyan// rang rang sa bon las 'od 'phros// ye shes spyan drangs so sor thim// spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rang bzhin dag pa sku gsum zhing khams nas/ khro rol phur bu'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// 'gro blo mos pa'i snang tshul mthun pa yi// sprul pa yang sprul 'gyed cing gshegs su gsol// badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rang rang dgyes pa'i gnas mchog so so ru// dam ye dbyer med chu la chu bzhag tshul// bzhugs nas sku gsung thugs kyi sgo phyes la// rnal 'byor lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs// de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ e ma hoḥ chos sku stong pa phyogs ris bral na yang*// longs sku 'gag med rgyan dang cha lugs 'chang*// skye 'gag 'gyur med gang 'dul sprul pa 'gyed/ khro rol phur bu'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hoḥ mchod yon me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// spyan gzigs dkor cha gang dgos yo byad sogs// phyi mchod dam pa 'bul lo dgyes par bzhes// hoḥ dbang po lnga yi me tog bsur chen spos// zhun chen mar me khrag gi dri chab dang*// sha khrag zhal zas thod rnga rkang gling sgra// mchod skong rten sgrub rdzas sogs nang mchod 'bul// hoḥ

sman rag gtor ma sbyor sgrol mchod pa dang*// tshogs kyi yo byad lus kyis brda gar rgya// ngag gis smra brjod gdung dbyangs sngags kyi sgra// yid kyis ting 'dzin gsang mchod don mchod 'bul// de nas bstod pa bya ba'i dang po zhi ba la bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ skye med chos kyi sku las longs skur bzhengs// gang 'dul sprul pas 'gro ba so sor 'dul// gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'od zer 'bar// mnyen lcugs 'khril ldem gzhon tshul zhi bar bstod/ khro bo la bstod pa ni/ chos sku zhi ba chen por g.yo min kyang*// ma rungs 'dul phyir khros pa'i ngang tshul ston// gar dgu'i nyams ldan durakhrod chas brgyad gsol// gdug pa'i tshogs 'joms sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// de nas bshags pa bya ba ni/ hoḥ bskal pa sngon nas da lta yan chad du// bdag sogs ma rig bag chags dbang gi mthus// 'gal 'khrul nyams chag mi dge'i rigs kun bshags// mi sgrib tshangs pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol// yi ge brgya pa brjod/ dzap ni so so blang bar bya/ rang rang thugs kar sa bon mthar// sngags bskor 'od kyis don gnyis byas// rtsa gsum byin rlabs rang la bsdus// mchog thun dngos grub thob par gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga ba te dz+nyā na badz+ra karma kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ āḥhrīḥhūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces so// tshogs byed par spro na bsham ste bran/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ hrīḥ me rlung chu 'phros tshogs kyi dngos zhen sbyangs// sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs// rang bzhin gnas nas ye shes lha tshogs rnams// 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// hūm̐ hrīḥ dur khrod gsang ba'i gnas mchog nyams re dga'// phyi nang gsang mchod tshogs gtor bcud re che// dgyes pa'i yo byad spyan gzigs bag re dro// rnal 'byor dam ldan 'tshogs pa dam re gtsang*// rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas dang// yi dam lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gror bcas// dam can chos skyong srung ma thugs dam bskang*// bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol//

'bul bshags bsgral mchod ni/ hūm̐/ tshogs rje tshogs bdag rnams la tshogs mchod 'bul// dam tshig chag nyams 'gal 'khrul mthol lo bshags// dgra bgegs log 'dren sgrol cig sha khrag rol// bdag gzhan bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shog / lhag ma chad mdo brtan skyong rnams dus gcig tu bshams la/ bh+yo/ lhag la dgyes pa rnams kyis lhag ma bzhes/ khas blangs dam bcas srung mas gtor ma longs// dbang phyug ma sring brtan ma'i tshogs rnams mchod// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// gtor bro ni/ hūm̐/ thabs shes khro bo khro mos bro brdungs pas// dgra bgegs dam sri pho mo rdul du rlog /gtor gzhong 'bar ba'i 'og tu log 'dren mnan// nam zhig byang chub mchog sems bskyed dus ldang*// de nas dngos grub len pa ni/ hoḥ bsgrubs pa'i lha rnams thugs dam ma g.yel cig /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las mchog thun mong*// dngos grub dam pa bdag la bstsal nas kyang*// tshe gcig rdo rje 'chang gi sku brnyes nas// rang gzhan don gnyis mtha' ru phyin mdzad gsol// sarba sid+dhi pha la hoḥ bsdu zhing rgyun spyod bkra shis bsngo smon ni/ hūm̐/ bskyed pa'i lha tshogs rang thim rang nyid kyang*// rim par hūm̐ bsdus thig ler 'dus nas yal// dmigs med spros bral rgya yan lhug par bzhag /snang grags rig gsum lha sngags ye shes rol// hoḥ phyogs dus mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum gyi// bden pa'i stobs kyis bkra shis bde legs stsol// bdag gzhan tshogs rdzogs sgrib byang don gnyis 'grub// sku bzhi lhun grub myur du thob par shog / ces pa 'di yang skyabs gnas rin po che 'jam mgon rig 'dzin gsung rab rgya mtshos bka' yang yang bstsal pa spyi bor blangs nas/ slob dpon pad+ma'i slob mar gyur pa'i skye mtha' yin par rloms pa/ gter ston rol pa rdo rjes blo nas gang dran bcos med du bris nas phul ba'o/// /
